factor_definition.vol60: std(close/preclose-1 with paused sessions set to zero, 60 rows, pandas ddof=1)
factor_definition.overnight20: rolling sum log(open/preclose), invalid ratios replaced by zero
factor_definition.intraday20: rolling sum log(close/open), invalid ratios replaced by zero
factor_definition.eligibility: listed main-board member; row age>=252; amount 20-row mean>=1e7; close>=2; not ST; trading; 0.001<vol60<0.09

online_update.label: product of close/preclose for the next 20 trading sessions minus one
online_update.label_completion: source-session index + 20; completion must be <= current signal-session index
online_update.label_missing_rule: all 20 daily close/preclose values must be finite and positive
online_update.ic: Spearman correlation of factor percentile rank and future-return percentile rank
online_update.window_rule: IC source session must be within [current_index-window+1,current_index] and its label complete
online_update.reliability: componentwise median(raw_ic*direction), clip below zero, normalize to sum one
online_update.fallback: baseline absolute weights when fewer than 60 complete IC sections or all clipped medians are zero
online_update.temporal_application: each signal session uses its own then-available weight; historical scores are never recomputed with later weights; 5-session smoothing is applied after daily weighting

ranking.tie_break: lexical symbol order through stable mergesort

evaluation.starts: every trading session in Q1 of each year 2016 through 2024
evaluation.end: last trading session of the same calendar year
evaluation.execution: next-session open daily-bar reconstruction matching the permitted Hushen1 execution source
evaluation.benchmark: SSE price index; start-session open to year-end close
hard_gates: each of nine annual median excess values > 0
each segment mean start-level excess > exact baseline
each segment mean start-level CAGR is no more than 0.02 below exact baseline
robustness_gates: annual median excess improves versus baseline in at least seven years
paired start-level excess improves versus baseline for more than half of starts
sample standard deviation of nine annual median excess values <= baseline
leave-one-year-out mean paired excess improvement > 0 for every omitted year
largest positive annual mean excess-improvement contribution / sum positive annual contributions < 0.50
the other mix for the same window has positive mean excess improvement in both segments
no unresolved corporate-action or execution-integrity issue
pass_order: smaller of two segment mean excess improvements descending
annual median excess standard deviation ascending

execution_assumptions.corporate_actions: cash, bonus/transfer shares, pay date, listing/release date and FIFO dividend tax from actions_pre2025.json
execution_assumptions.delisting: zero recovery at historical outDate if still held, recorded as an integrity failure

stress.capacity_40pct: multiply both average-volume participation and daily-volume acceptance limits by 0.40
stress.scope: baseline and all four frozen candidates; failures retained
